A1.justification: Both PDFs describe NexusFlow and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary Sections A and B. The material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original nuScenes and NYU-V2 experiments, representation analyses, efficiency measurements, and supplementary ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in the main text and supplementary Sections A and B.

M1.justification: Equations (3) and (4) change the stated pairwise and center-based alignment objectives from sums of L2 norms to sums of squared L2 norms. The architecture remains unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether this correction involved implementation changes or retraining.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate nuScenes tracking and mapping and NYU-V2 segmentation, depth, and surface normals. The standard and reversed geographic supervision scenarios already appear in both appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including MTPSL and JTR in the nuScenes comparisons and MTPSL in the NYU-V2 comparisons. 'Oracle' is renamed 'Full-supervision' with the same supervision conditions and scores.

E3.justification: The geographic supervision protocol, complete nuScenes validation set, clustered NYU-V2 label partitions, 288×384 resizing, evaluation metrics, and reported training configurations remain unchanged. No new evaluation procedure is introduced.

E4.justification: Both retain the t-SNE, MMD, and PCA analyses; coupling-layer ablations; qualitative examples; and appendix tests of aggregators, geographic supervision reversal, and layer counts. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains identical ± reporting. Neither version adds run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or explanations of uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Reported values in Tables 1–5 and A.1–B.2, plotted results, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, two-stage nuScenes AMOTA remains 0.329, and NYU-V2 center-based segmentation IoU remains 31.70.

T1.justification: The squared-norm definitions in Equations (3) and (4) revise the mathematics. For two-task pairwise alignment, this makes the loss definition consistent with the square-root step in Lemma 1. The lemma's assumptions, bound, and proof otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about domain-partitioned heterogeneous-task learning, invertible alignment, avoiding collapse, and generality across driving and indoor prediction.

C2.justification: Interpretations of alignment, dimensionality preservation, knowledge transfer, and baseline failures remain unchanged. The added sentence after Lemma 1 restates its existing interpretation; no substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 explicitly identifies standard RealNVP coupling and explains that its closed-form inverse reuses the forward s/t networks without inverting the MLPs. This adds technical clarification; hardware, implementation settings, training-time information, and the repository link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds InfoCD and Consid-Gen to the bibliography, removes the weighted-Chamfer loss-distillation paper, and adjusts several citation placements. It also explicitly attributes the coupling transform to RealNVP. The central research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: There are short explanatory additions in Sections 3.2–3.3, limited wording edits, the Oracle-to-Full-supervision renaming, and changes to affiliation and corresponding-author information. The narrative and section structure are retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 moves from PDF page 6 to 7, and Table 3 from page 7 to 8, causing local reflow. Captions, table labels, spacing, and page numbering receive small changes; all figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The squared-loss correction improves consistency between the pairwise objective and Lemma 1's square-root step, while the RealNVP explanation clarifies invertibility. These provide limited gains in mathematical and technical clarity. The empirical evidence and appendix analyses remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish implementation changes or reruns.
